welcome.title: Learn English with Play
welcome.body: Short lessons, a story that continues, and honest numbers about how you're doing.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Resetting a password by email isn't available on this server yet.
forgot.help: If you can't sign in, write to support from the email address you signed up with and we'll help you get back in. Never send us your password.
forgot.intro: Enter the email you signed up with. If an account uses it, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses {email}, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works once, for {minutes} minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing yet? Look in spam, or ask again in a few minutes — a new link replaces the old one.

age.title: What year were you born?
age.body: We ask everyone. It decides which protections your account gets.

notYet.title: See you in a few years!
notYet.body: This course is for learners aged 13 and over. A course for younger learners isn't ready yet.
notYet.tip: Until then, songs, cartoons and games in English are a great start.

why.title: Why do you want English?
why.body: This shapes what we show you first.
why.people: To talk with friends and family

l1.title: What's your first language?
l1.body: Word meanings and tips come in this language. The app's own menus have their own setting.
l1.spellingTitle: Which English voice would you like?
l1.spellingBody: Both spellings are always accepted in your answers.

level.title: Do you know any English already?

placement.title: Where do you want to start?
placement.body: Once your account exists, a 3-minute level check can suggest where to start (Profile → Find your level). For now, start at the beginning or pick a section — you can change this any time.

time.title: How much time per day?
time.body: Pick what you can really keep up. Short and regular beats long and rare.
time.perYear: {hours, plural, one {about # hour a year} other {about # hours a year}}

plan.title: When and where will you study?
plan.body: People who pick a time and place keep going far more often. We'll remind you then — and only then.
plan.webNote: Reminders work in the phone app. On the web we won't send any.
plan.quietNote: We never remind you between 21:00 and 08:00.

expect.title: How long this really takes
expect.quote: At 20 minutes a day, you'll reach B1 in about 3 years and C2 in about 10. At 60 minutes a day: B1 in about a year, C2 in about 3. We'll show you real progress either way.

account.title: Create your account
account.body: Your progress is kept with your account.
account.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

first.title: Say your first English sentence
first.body: Listen, then say it out loud. Nobody else hears it.
first.done: You just said your first English sentence.
first.doneBody: That's the whole method: small real pieces of English, often.

settings.serverOwned: These are kept with your account. Changing them from the app isn't available yet.
settings.voiceConsentHelp: Record your voice for pronunciation and speaking practice. Recordings are scored on our server, kept at most 30 days and never shared. Turning this off deletes every recording.
settings.trainingOptInHelp: Lets us use your recordings to improve how speech is scored. It stays off unless you turn it on. We don't use recordings this way yet; your choice is kept for when we do.
settings.pauseDataHelp: While this is on, no new recordings or writing are sent to us. Lessons and reviews keep working.
settings.exportHelpAccount: Everything about you, as one JSON file: your account's data on our server (answers, progress, chats and recordings) and everything this device holds.
settings.exportAccountMissing: Your account's copy couldn't be included because you're offline or the server didn't answer. The file has what this device holds; export again when you're online.
settings.deleteRecordingsHelp: Deletes every voice recording of yours on our server, now.
settings.recordingsDeleted: {count, plural, =0 {There were no recordings to delete.} one {# recording deleted.} other {# recordings deleted.}}
settings.deleteAccountServerHelp: Deletes your account and everything in it from our server (progress, answers, chats and recordings), then everything on this device. This can't be undone.
settings.startPoint: Where I start on the path
settings.interfaceLanguageHelp: The language of menus and buttons. Word meanings follow your first language.
settings.dyslexiaFontHelp: Uses Lexend for menus and buttons. English you're learning stays in Andika.
settings.timersHelp: Below B2 there are no timers unless you turn on timed practice. Games keep their clock unless you choose No timers.
settings.timedModeHelp: Adds each exercise's time limit before B2, where it normally starts.
settings.noAudioHelp: Listening exercises use the written words instead, and exercises that only work with sound are left out.
settings.noVisionHelp: Matching, sorting and ordering become lists you can move through one item at a time.
settings.recordingsPrivate: Your recordings never leave this device, and they're deleted when a lesson ends. Sending recordings for marking isn't switched on yet.
settings.voiceNote: No human recordings exist yet. Your device's own English voice reads everything, marked “Synthetic voice”. The accent follows your English variety.
settings.remindersWeb: Reminders work in the phone app.
settings.remindersDenied: Notifications are off for this app in your device settings.
settings.remindersReduced: You haven't opened the last few reminders, so we've cut them to once a week. Want to pause them instead?
settings.exportHelp: Everything this device holds about you, as a JSON file: your settings, your progress on this device and your unsent answers.
settings.exportAccount: Your account's own copy of your data can't be exported from the app yet.
settings.deleteDeviceHelp: Removes your progress, saved words and unsent answers from this device and signs you out. Your account itself is not deleted.
settings.deleteAccountHelp: Deleting your account from the app isn't available yet. Write to support from your account's email address and we'll delete it.
settings.pending: {count, plural, =0 {No answers waiting to be sent.} one {# answer is waiting on this device to be sent.} other {# answers are waiting on this device to be sent.}}

settings.checksBad: The course files don't match what this app expects.
settings.diagnosticsHelp: Recent technical events on this device, with no personal details. Useful if support asks.
settings.defectsHelp: Exercises this app hides because of a known content problem, reported to the course team.
settings.startPointHelp: Continue on the path starts from the first unfinished lesson from this section on.
settings.exportUnavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device, so the file couldn't be handed over.
settings.soundEffectsHelp: Soft chimes for answers and celebrations. Never during the voice.
settings.hapticsHelp: A light tap you can feel with each answer.

levelAward.title: What the {level} award asks for
levelAward.intro: {level} is awarded when all four of these hold, never by the path alone. Here is where each stands now.
levelAward.awarded: You've earned {level}: all four conditions hold.
levelAward.fragile: You passed the test, but a lot of this is still fragile. Let's consolidate for two weeks and then certify.
levelAward.coverage: {value}% of the level's syllabus passed at tier 2 — it needs {need}%.
levelAward.retention: {value}% of what you've learned is remembered well — it needs {need}%.
levelAward.exam: {value}% overall in the level exam — it needs {need}%, with no paper below its bar.
levelAward.examNotTaken: The level exam hasn't been taken yet — it needs {need}% overall.
levelAward.production: Band {value} in writing and speaking — it needs band {need}.
levelAward.productionNone: Writing and speaking haven't been scored yet — they need band {need}.

exam.title: {level} exam
exam.rulePapers: Three papers: listening, reading and use of English, with questions from across {level}.
exam.ruleTime: Take it in one sitting. Answers that reach us after the exam ends don't count.
exam.ruleNoMarks: No right or wrong is shown until the end, and there are no hints.
exam.ruleCondition: Passing is one of the four conditions for {level}; it never awards the level on its own.
exam.unavailable: The level exam needs a connection to the server.
exam.questions: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}, paper by paper.
exam.endsAt: The exam ends at {time}. Answers must reach us before then.
exam.passMarks: To pass: {overall}% overall, and no paper below {paper}%.
exam.missing: {count, plural, one {# question isn't} other {# questions aren't}} in this version of the app and will count as unanswered. Update the app first if you can.
exam.reused: Some questions come from an earlier exam: there aren't enough new ones yet.
exam.offlineBody: The server could not be reached, so the exam isn't marked yet. Answers count only if they reach us before {time} — check again as soon as you're online.
exam.passedBody: The exam counts toward {level}. The level is awarded when all four conditions hold — see Progress.
exam.notYetBody: Your answers still count as practice. Take another exam when you're ready; it uses new questions where it can.

writing.title: Writing for {level}
writing.intro: Writing counts toward {level}. Each piece is rated once, on five criteria, and every band comes with the sentences of yours that earned it.
writing.unavailable: Writing tasks need a connection to the server.
writing.none: There are no writing tasks for {level} yet.
writing.count: {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} · aim for {min}–{max}
writing.tooLong: That's longer than the task asks ({max} words). Keeping to it is part of the task.
writing.once: Each text is rated once; sending the same text again shows the same score.
writing.awaiting: It will be rated as soon as a rater is available, and then counts toward {level} on Progress.
writing.bandNote: The overall band is the middle of the five, held down by any weak criterion. {level} needs band {need}.
writing.formative: Practice feedback: this rater hasn't been checked against human raters yet, so this score doesn't certify a level.
writing.borderline: This score is close to the level's band, so a person will check it.
writing.appeal: I think this score is wrong
writing.appealReason: What should be looked at again?
writing.appealed: Your appeal is in: a person who doesn't see this score will rate your writing again.

audit.title: Memory check
audit.introTitle: How well do you really remember?
audit.ruleWhat: About 20 things the app thinks you know well, from across what you've learned.
audit.ruleCold: Answer them without looking anything up, in one go — within a day of starting.
audit.ruleWhy: We compare what you remember with what we predicted. If memory is weaker than predicted, reviews come a little more often.
audit.ruleMonthly: Once a month. Your answers also count as reviews.
audit.unavailable: The memory check needs a connection to the server.
audit.offlineBody: The server could not be reached, so the check isn't finished yet. Check again when you're online — within a day of starting.
audit.compare: We predicted you'd remember about {predicted}% — you remembered {actual}%.
audit.onTrack: Your reviews are well timed: nothing needs to change.
audit.raised: Memory was weaker than predicted, so reviews will now come a little more often (aiming at {target}%). More of what you learn will stay.
audit.next: Your coverage figure on Progress is now checked rather than estimated. The next check is in a month.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Pick a new password for your account. Every device signed in to it will be signed out.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password. Every device that was signed in has been signed out.
reset.invalidTitle: This link doesn't work any more
reset.invalidBody: A link works once, for a short time, and a newer one replaces it. Ask for a new link.
reset.missingToken: This page needs the link from the email. Ask for a new link if you can't find it.
reset.signedInNote: Saving the new password also signs this device out.

password.title: Change password
password.hint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out; this one stays signed in.

examReport.title: Your exam report
examReport.note: This is an internal assessment by the app, not an accredited qualification.
examReport.overall: Overall {value}% at {level}. Read it with each paper below.

band.secure: Secure — well above what the level asks.
band.borderline: Above the paper's minimum, below the overall bar.

examReport.paperDetail: {answered} of {asked} answered. The level asks {overallBar}% overall and at least {paperBar}% on each paper.
examReport.paperPace: About {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} an answer.
examReport.notAssessed: Not assessed yet at this level.
examReport.noNorms: Comparing with other learners at this level needs answers from many of them; there aren't enough yet, so no comparison is shown.
examReport.vocabularyLine: You know {known, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} — {levelKnown} of the {levelTotal} taught at {level}.
examReport.coverageEstimate: They cover about {percent}% of everyday English. This is an estimate.
examReport.readingTarget: Reading target at this level: {wpm} words a minute.
examReport.speechTarget: Speaking target at this level: {wpm} words a minute.
examReport.speechRateLater: Your own speech rate is measured once recorded speech can be scored.
examReport.speechRate: Your speech rate: {wpm} words a minute.
examReport.timelineWeeks: About {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} to the end of {next} at your pace of {pace} units a week ({units} units left).
examReport.timelineNoPace: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} left to the end of {next}. Finish a few units and an estimate will appear.
examReport.timelineDone: You've finished every unit up to the end of {next}.
examReport.timelineTop: C2 is the top of the course.

pronunciation.headline: Pronunciation: {value} out of 100
pronunciation.practise: Worth practising — the sounds below are the place to start.
pronunciation.kept: Your recording is kept until {date}, then deleted.
pronunciation.failed: Your pronunciation couldn't be checked this time. Your answer still counts.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.explainer: A weekly XP ladder with 30 people at a similar pace. Some people find it motivating; some find it stressful. You can leave any time.
leagues.seenBy: Others in your league see your display name and your XP for the week, and nothing else.
leagues.countsOnly: Only XP from scheduled work counts. Revision doesn’t.
leagues.nameHint: 2–24 letters or digits. Not your email.
leagues.nameCharacters: Use letters, digits, spaces, _ or - only, with at least one letter.
leagues.minor: Leagues are for adults, so they aren't offered on this account.
leagues.noGroupYet: Your group of up to 30 forms with your first lesson this week.
leagues.leaveBody: Your tier is kept for 4 weeks.
leagues.unavailable: Leagues aren't available on this server yet.

arcade.title: Play lab
arcade.eyebrow: A little play. A lot of progress.
arcade.subtitle: Build your vocabulary with short games from your course. No timer. No lost lives.
arcade.chooseGame: How do you want to play?
arcade.meaningSub: Connect English words with their meanings.
arcade.spellingSub: Recall the English word and write it yourself.
arcade.listeningSub: Listen closely. Find the word you hear.
arcade.audioOff: Listening is off in your accessibility settings. You can still explore words and practise spelling.
arcade.empty: This topic does not have enough distinct translated words. Choose another topic.
arcade.note: Game results describe this round only. They do not award course XP or certify a CEFR level.
arcade.resultNote: Every attempt is practice. Revisit the words that need another look.
arcade.listeningPrompt: Which English word do you hear?
arcade.trySub: Try a vocabulary game right away. No account needed.
arcade.feature1Sub: Explore the course from first words to advanced English.
arcade.feature2Sub: Practise with listening, stories, speaking and writing.
arcade.feature3Sub: Get feedback, revisit words and learn at your pace.
